mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant (id, code, name, status, org_id, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) VALUES (#{id}, #{code}, #{name}, #{status}, #{orgId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tenant WHERE id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1
SELECT status FROM tenant WHERE id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tenant t WHERE (#{keyword} = '' OR t.id LIKE #{like} OR t.code LIKE #{like} OR t.name LIKE #{like})

SELECT t.id AS tenantId, t.code, t.name, t.status, t.org_id AS orgId, IFNULL(t.shadow_enabled, 0) AS shadowEnabled, IFNULL(t.active_db_role, 'PRIMARY') AS activeDbRole, t.shadow_maintenance_state AS shadowMaintenanceState, t.create_time AS createTime, t.update_time AS updateTime FROM tenant t WHERE (#{keyword} = '' OR t.id LIKE #{like} OR t.code LIKE #{like} OR t.name LIKE #{like}) ORDER BY t.create_time DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT t.id AS tenantId, t.code, t.name, t.status, t.org_id AS orgId, IFNULL(t.shadow_enabled, 0) AS shadowEnabled, IFNULL(t.active_db_role, 'PRIMARY') AS activeDbRole, t.shadow_maintenance_state AS shadowMaintenanceState, t.create_time AS createTime, t.update_time AS updateTime FROM tenant t WHERE t.id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM tenant WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT id, org_id FROM tenant WHERE 1 = 1 AND org_id IS NOT NULL AND org_id != ''
SELECT status, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM tenant GROUP BY status
SELECT id AS tenantId, code, name FROM tenant

SELECT id AS tenantId, IFNULL(shadow_enabled, 0) AS shadowEnabled, IFNULL(active_db_role, 'PRIMARY') AS activeDbRole, shadow_maintenance_state AS maintenanceState, shadow_maintenance_until AS maintenanceUntil FROM tenant WHERE id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant SET shadow_enabled = 1, active_db_role = 'PRIMARY', shadow_maintenance_state = NULL, shadow_maintenance_until = NULL, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_user = #{updateUser} WHERE id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM tenant WHERE shadow_enabled = 1 AND status = 'ACTIVE'
